title: KCP model_complete result (DESIGN.md §16.1-§16.3; derived)
description: CommandResult.result payload for model_complete (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). This closed object IS the worker's whole view of a model call: bounded output, metered usage, the effect and attempt identity, and the two manifest refs an auditor can follow. What it cannot carry is the point — there is no provider, host, URL, path, header, credential, credential reference, or provider-request byte member here, so a credential cannot reach worker-visible state even by accident (§16.3 step 7: bounded output returned through the supervisor). `state` is the §16.1 effect state: `ambiguous` sets retry_frozen and requires reconciliation; `text` is absent unless the state is `completed`.

effect_id.description: The local §16.1 Effect, committed prepared before any permit was consumed.

effect_attempt_id.description: The §16.1 EffectAttempt, committed dispatching before the first byte left.

state.description: The terminal §16.1 attempt state. `failed` means a definite outcome; `ambiguous` means a request may have been transmitted — retry is frozen and an operator reconciles. `prepared`, `dispatching`, and `canceled` are never returned: this operation always terminalizes or refuses.

text.description: The model's bounded output. Present only when state is `completed`.

model.description: The model revision the provider says answered, where known (§16.3 step 6).

provider_ref.description: The provider's own id for the response: the effect receipt's external_ref.

usage.description: Token usage as the provider reported it (§16.3 step 6), the same measurement reported to byom's trusted-meter channel.

disclosure_manifest_ref.description: The §16.2 DisclosureManifest — {region, retention, training_use} and every exact item — that the byom permit bound. Readable via disclosure_manifest_show.

provider_context_manifest_ref.description: The §16.3 ProviderContextManifest: the complete ordered chain to the final provider-request byte digest. Audit data, not a bearer grant.

retry_frozen.description: True exactly when state is `ambiguous`: automatic retry is frozen because a duplicate call could double the disclosure and the cost (§16.1).

usage_reported.description: Whether the measured usage reached byom's meter channel. Kovee's report is evidence; the ledger move is byom's (§11.4, family contract L33).

observation.description: The exact observation that justifies a `failed` or `ambiguous` classification (§16.1). Bounded, and never a provider response body verbatim.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).
